verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer is a venture-focused law firm, so versioned public APIs with a deprecation policy are outside what buyers comparing law firms would ask. Its client tools (GDHQ, the Contract Generator, the D&O portal, ChatGD) are web apps or internal tools with no documented API. Probes for OpenAPI specs and llms.txt all returned 404, so nothing shows the firm ships an API that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
